title: Remove redundant Set 1/3 text from workout screen
description: The active workout screen shows both set progress bubbles AND a 'SET 1 / 3' text label. The bubbles are sufficient and preferred - remove the text label to clean up the UI.
close_reason: Removed redundant SET x/y text label, bubbles are sufficient

title: Delete unused getScheduledWorkoutsByDay and getExerciseType
description: getScheduledWorkoutsByDay in schedule/api.ts is never called. getExerciseType in progress/api.ts is never referenced. Remove both.
close_reason: Deleted unused getScheduledWorkoutsByDay and getExerciseType

title: Delete dead RestTimerOverlay component
description: RestTimerOverlay.tsx is exported from components/index.ts but never imported anywhere. Rest timer is fully inlined in ActiveWorkout.tsx. Delete the file and remove the export.
close_reason: Deleted RestTimerOverlay.tsx and removed export

title: Migrate ExerciseAutocomplete to design system
description: ExerciseAutocomplete.tsx uses raw Tailwind classes (border-gray-300, focus:ring-blue-500, bg-blue-50, etc.) instead of the CSS custom property design system. Used in every template exercise row so high visibility.
close_reason: Closed

title: History page - clickable workouts with exercise detail view
description: History page currently shows completed workouts but you can't drill into them. Make the list items clickable to show a detail view with all exercises, sets, weights, and reps that were actually logged.

title: Skip button missing on last set and second-to-last rest
description: The Skip button doesn't appear on the rest period before the last set of an exercise, which means you can't skip into the last set. Also doesn't appear on the last set itself. Should be available on every set and every rest period.
close_reason: Show skip button on all sets and rest periods (except last exercise)

title: Custom rest timer ignored - always defaults to 1:30
description: When setting a custom rest period (something other than 1:30) on an exercise, the rest timer still shows 1:30 between sets. The per-exercise rest_seconds value isn't being picked up by the active workout timer.
close_reason: Added rest_seconds to insert payloads in createTemplate and updateTemplate

title: Extract toLocalDateString helper for YYYY-MM-DD
description: The local date string construction pattern is hand-built in DashboardPage.tsx, workouts/api.ts, and progress/api.ts. Extract a toLocalDateString() helper in lib/utils.ts.
close_reason: Extracted toLocalDateString() helper, replaced 3 inline constructions

title: Replace browser confirm() with ConfirmDialog component
description: ActiveWorkout.tsx and SchedulePage.tsx use native confirm() for destructive actions. Should use the existing ConfirmDialog component for consistency and testability.
close_reason: Closed

title: Hide top nav menu during active workout
description: The Dashboard/Templates/Schedule nav tabs and sign out button remain visible during an active workout. Hide them while in workout mode since the user won't navigate during exercise. Show just the workout header bar (Cancel, progress, elapsed time).
close_reason: Added WorkoutModeContext to hide Layout header during active workout

title: Workout name truncated behind Start Workout button
description: On the Today's Workout card, the workout name (e.g. WEDNESDAY - ...) gets cut off behind the Start Workout button. Rearrange the layout so the full name is visible - consider stacking the button below the title or giving the title its own full-width row.
close_reason: Moved title to full-width row, button and exercise count on second row

title: Lazy-load Recharts for bundle size reduction
description: Recharts is ~300KB and only used in ExerciseHistoryView. Use React.lazy + Suspense to code-split it. Also consider route-level code splitting in App.tsx.
close_reason: Closed

title: Replace onMouseEnter/Leave hover hacks with CSS classes
description: ~10 pairs of inline JS hover handlers across Layout, ActiveWorkout, etc. simulating CSS hover because design system uses CSS variables. Define hover utility classes in index.css instead.
close_reason: Closed

title: Dashboard this-week volume doesn't update after workout completes
description: After finishing a workout, the This Week volume number on the dashboard doesn't automatically refresh. User has to reload the page to see the updated count.
close_reason: Fixed timezone bug in weekly volume date comparison - used parseLocalDate instead of new Date for date-only strings

title: Split progress/api.ts into smaller modules
description: At 662 lines, progress/api.ts mixes exercise history, PR checking, chart data, and weekly volume. Split into exerciseApi.ts, volumeApi.ts, and move calculateEstimated1RM to lib/utils.ts.
close_reason: Closed

title: Rest screen header text too small
description: The REST label on the rest timer screen is undersized relative to the countdown digits. Make it more prominent so the screen reads clearly at a glance from across the room.
close_reason: Bumped REST header from text-3xl to text-5xl with uppercase tracking-widest

title: Auto-estimate weights when scheduling a workout
description: Add a 'Use Estimated' button on the schedule workout screen that auto-fills target weights for each exercise. Logic: look up previous logged sets for that exercise (or similar), calculate e1RM, then set target weight to 70% of e1RM rounded down to nearest 5#. Saves the user from manually entering weights for every exercise.

title: Extract useDashboardData hook from DashboardPage
description: DashboardPage has 6+ useState calls mixing data fetching with rendering. Extract data fetching into a useDashboardData() hook.
close_reason: Closed

title: Add Ignition set + effective reps exercise type
description: New exercise modality: Ignition sets with effective reps. Workflow: do a 12-rep ignition set at a weight where you'd fail at 12-14 reps. Take a 30-second rest, then grind out 20 additional effective reps in as many mini-sets as needed with 15-30 seconds between each. Then 3-minute rest before the next exercise. Needs schema changes (new exercise type or mode flag), template/schedule support, and active workout UI that guides the user through the ignition set -> short rests -> effective reps flow with rep counting.

title: Migrate AdminPage dialogs to design system
description: MergeDialog and EditDialog in AdminPage.tsx still use old Tailwind dark: classes (bg-white dark:bg-gray-800, etc.) instead of the CSS custom property design system used everywhere else.
close_reason: Closed

title: Dashboard completed workout should show adjusted weights/reps
description: When a workout is completed and the user adjusted weights or reps during the session, the dashboard summary should reflect the actual logged values rather than the originally scheduled targets.
close_reason: Dashboard now shows actual logged weights/sets/reps for completed workouts instead of planned values

title: Deduplicate DAYS_OF_WEEK constant
description: Defined separately in SchedulePage.tsx and WeeklyCalendar.tsx with slightly different shapes. Extract to a shared constants file.
close_reason: Moved DAYS_OF_WEEK to lib/utils.ts, removed from SchedulePage and WeeklyCalendar

title: Rename duplicate getRecentWorkouts functions
description: Two functions named getRecentWorkouts exist: progress/api.ts returns lightweight RecentWorkout summaries, workouts/api.ts returns full WorkoutSessionWithSets. Rename the workouts one to getWorkoutSessionsWithSets or similar.
close_reason: Renamed workouts/api getRecentWorkouts to getWorkoutSessionsWithSets
